headline: EPS turns profitable but slips sequentially
summary_short: KNC Laboratories reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥5.30, down 60.8% q/q from ¥13.53.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥5.30 fell 60.8% sequentially from ¥13.53 in the prior quarter, but turned profitable versus a year-ago loss of ¥1.46 per share. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
